title: Reel: the sale is over, write three lines (Decoded #7)
hook: The sale is over. Before the ads get archived, write three lines.
caption:
The sale is over. Before the ads get archived, write three lines.

1. The reason to buy your top-spending ads gave: discount, gift, deadline or bundle.
2. The first shot of each of those ads. Screenshot it.
3. The ads that got no spend, and what they had in common.

That is one page. It is also the brief for your next sale, and the Republic Day sales are closer than they look.

Read the full newsletter on our website, link in bio.
alt_text: Reel cover in Galvor violet and gold reading: Sale over. Write three lines. The reel shows a one-page note filling in with three lines: the reason to buy, the first shot, and what got no spend. End card: read the full newsletter, link in bio.
cta: Read the full newsletter on our website, link in bio

script.setup: Idea: a D2C growth lead who has just closed a sale and is about to move on, so the next sale starts from a blank page. On-screen title: Sale over. Write three lines. Expectation set: three specific things to write down. The script meets it by the second scene and beats it by turning the three lines into the brief for the next sale. Outline: the reason to buy that carried the sale (second-best, first); the first shot that held (best, second); what got no spend.

scenes.visual: A sale banner peels off a calendar. A single revenue figure, blurred, is filed into a folder.
scenes.voiceover: The sale is over. Most teams save the revenue number.

scenes.visual: The folder closes. A blank one-page note opens beside it with three empty lines.
scenes.voiceover: That number can't brief your next sale. Three lines can.
scenes.on_screen: Three lines brief the next sale

scenes.visual: Line one fills in on the note. A row of dummy ad tiles is sorted by spend, top three highlighted.
scenes.voiceover: Line one: the reason to buy your top-spending ads gave.

scenes.visual: Four labels appear: discount, gift, deadline, bundle. One gets circled.
scenes.voiceover: Discount, gift, deadline or bundle. Name the one that carried it.

scenes.visual: A viewer's thumb hovers over a phone, about to scroll.
scenes.voiceover: A reason only works if people stay to hear it.
scenes.on_screen: Did people stay to hear it?

scenes.visual: Line two fills in. Opening frames of the top ads are pasted into the note as small screenshots.
scenes.voiceover: Line two: screenshot the first shot of each top ad.

scenes.visual: Line three fills in. A group of greyed-out tiles is circled together.
scenes.voiceover: Line three: the ads that got no spend, and what they shared.

scenes.visual: The finished page slides onto a January calendar next to a Republic Day sale marker.
scenes.voiceover: One page today. No blank page before the Republic Day sale.

scenes.visual: End card with the Galvor logo and a link-in-bio arrow. Chime.
scenes.voiceover: Read the full newsletter on our website, link in bio.

script.music: Light instrumental bed, low under the voice. Soft chime on the end card only.
script.notes: AI voiceover over motion graphics. No presenter and no first person singular. Captions burned in for muted viewing. Use dummy ad tiles only, never a client account or name. Newsletter reel for Decoded #7 (The Sale Is Over. What Did Your Ads Learn?), out the same morning. No numbers used. Do not show real revenue figures or a real account.

slides.headline: One page now. *No blank page* in January.
slides.sub: Read the full newsletter on our website.
